title: Ferdinand Huyck
summary: "Ferdinand Huyck" by J. van Lennep is a historical adventure novel published in 1840. When young lawyer Ferdinand returns to Amsterdam after two years in Italy, he becomes entangled in dangerous encounters and mysterious obligations. A chance meeting with a fugitive sea captain—whom he vows never to betray—pulls him into a web of secrets involving threatened maidens, rival suitors, stolen jewels, and hidden identities. As complications mount and his father, the chief magistrate, searches for the very man Ferdinand protects, loyalties and honor collide in this tale of adventure and romance.
